def plot_images(images, labels, n_rows=3, n_cols=3, fig_size=2):
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_cols,n_rows, figsize=(fig_size*n_rows, fig_size*n_cols))
    fig.subplots_adjust(hspace=.5)
    for r in range(n_rows):
        for c in range(n_cols):
            i = r*n_cols + c
            axes[c][r].imshow(images[i], cmap='gray')
            axes[c][r].set_title(f'{labels[i]}')
            axes[c][r].axis('off')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig("dataset.png")
    plt.show()

def plot_dataset(x,y, n_rows=3, n_cols=3, fig_size=2, label_map=None):
    if label_map is not None:
        y = label_map[y]
    plot_images(x, y, n_rows, n_cols, fig_size)
In [ ]:

Preprocesado¶

In [ ]:
def preprocess(imgs : np.array, collapse=True) -> np.array:
    imgs = tf.cast(imgs, tf.float32) / 255.0
    if collapse:
        imgs = rearrange(imgs, "b h w -> b (h w)")
    return imgs

Normalización¶

In [ ]:
means = tf.reduce_mean(tf.cast(x_train, tf.float32)) / 255.0
stds  = tf.math.reduce_std(tf.cast(x_train, tf.float32)) / 255.0

means, stds
Out[ ]:
(<tf.Tensor: shape=(), dtype=float32, numpy=0.28604057>,
 <tf.Tensor: shape=(), dtype=float32, numpy=0.35302407>)
In [ ]:
def preprocess_norm(imgs : np.array, collapse=True) -> np.array:
    imgs = tf.cast(imgs, tf.float32) / 255.0
    imgs = (imgs - means) / stds
    if collapse:
        imgs = rearrange(imgs, "b h w -> b (h w)")
    return imgs

PCA¶

In [ ]:
def plot_variancia_acumulada(pca, percentiles=[90,95], colores=['r','g'], nombre="*"):
    var = pca.explained_variance_ratio_.cumsum()

    plt.plot([i for i in range(1, len(var)+1)], var,)

    # Dibujar los percentiles sobre la gráfica.
    for percentil,color in zip(percentiles, colores):
        p = np.argmax(var > (percentil/100.0)) + 1
        plt.axvline(x=p, color=color, linestyle='--', label=f'percentil {percentil} ({p})')

    plt.legend()

    plt.xlabel('Dimensiones')
    plt.ylabel('Varianza Acumulada')
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.savefig(f"codo-varianza-{nombre}.png", bbox_inches='tight')

def preprocess_pca(imgs : np.array, pca=pca_188, collapse=True) -> np.array:
    imgs = tf.cast(imgs, tf.float32) / 255.0
    imgs = (imgs - means) / stds
    if collapse:
        imgs = rearrange(imgs, "b h w -> b (h w)")
    return pca.transform(imgs)

lda = sklearn.discriminant_analysis.LinearDiscriminantAnalysis()

def preprocess_lda(imgs : np.array, lda=lda, collapse=True) -> np.array:
    imgs = tf.cast(imgs, tf.float32) / 255.0
    imgs = (imgs - means) / stds
    if collapse:
        imgs = rearrange(imgs, "b h w -> b (h w)")
    return lda.transform(imgs)

Detección de bordes¶

In [ ]:
import cv2 as cv

def preprocess_canny(imgs : np.array, low=100, high=200, collapse=True) -> np.array:
    imgs = tf.map_fn(lambda img: cv.Canny(img.numpy(), low, high), imgs)
    imgs = tf.cast(imgs, tf.float32) / 255.0
    if collapse:
        imgs = rearrange(imgs, "b h w -> b (h w)")
    return imgs

Sklearn MLP¶

In [ ]:
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier

def train_skleanr_mlp(preprocess=preprocess, **kargs):
    model = MLPClassifier(**kargs)

    # Training
    if preprocess:
        imgs = preprocess(x_train)
    else:
        imgs = x_train
    model.fit(imgs, y_train)

    # Eval
    if preprocess:
        imgs = preprocess(x_test)
    else:
        imgs = x_test
    predict_labels = model.predict(imgs)
    score = sklearn.metrics.accuracy_score(y_test, predict_labels)

    return model, score

def plot_loss(models, nombres, path):
    for i, model in enumerate(models):
        plt.plot(model.loss_curve_, label = nombres[i])
    #plt.plot(history.history['val_accuracy'])
    plt.title('Model Loss')
    plt.ylabel('Loss')
    plt.xlabel('Épocas')
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.legend(loc='upper right')
    plt.savefig(f"Loss_{path}.png", bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

def plot_accs(accuracies, nombres, path):
    bars=plt.bar(nombres, accuracies)
    plt.title('Model Accuracy')
    plt.ylabel('Accuracy')
    plt.xlabel('Modelo')
    plt.legend(loc='upper right')
    plt.bar_label(bars)
    plt.savefig(f"Acc_{path}.png", bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

Keras MLP¶

In [ ]:
from keras.models import Sequential
from keras.layers import Dense,Input
from keras.utils import to_categorical
from keras.optimizers import Adam
In [ ]:
def train_keras_mlp(preprocess=preprocess, **kargs):
    # Preprocess
    if preprocess:
        x = preprocess(x_train)
    else:
        x = x_train

    # Create model
    model = Sequential()
    model.add(Input(shape=(x.shape[-1],)))
    for size in kargs['hidden_layer_sizes']:
        model.add(Dense(size, kernel_initializer="he_normal", activation='relu'))
    model.add(Dense(10, kernel_initializer="he_normal", activation='softmax'))

    opt = Adam(learning_rate=kargs['learning_rate_init'])
    model.compile(loss='categorical_crossentropy', optimizer=opt, metrics=['accuracy'])

    # Train
    y_train_one_hot = to_categorical(y_train, num_classes=10)
    historial = model.fit(x, y_train_one_hot, epochs=kargs['max_iter'], batch_size=kargs['batch_size'])

    # Eval
    if preprocess:
        x = preprocess(x_test)
    else:
        x = x_test
    y_test_one_hot = to_categorical(y_test, num_classes=10)
    loss, accuracy = model.evaluate(x, y_test_one_hot, batch_size=10000)
    accuracy = tf.reduce_mean(accuracy)

    return model, historial, loss, accuracy

def plot_accuracy(historiales, nombres, path):
    for i, historial in enumerate(historiales):
        plt.plot(historial.history['accuracy'], label = nombres[i])
    #plt.plot(history.history['val_accuracy'])
    plt.title('Model Accuracy')
    plt.ylabel('Accuracy')
    plt.xlabel('Época')
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.legend(loc='lower right')
    plt.savefig(f"Accuracy_{path}.png", bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

def plot_loss(historiales, nombres, path):
    for i, historial in enumerate(historiales):
        plt.plot(historial.history['loss'], label = nombres[i])
    #plt.plot(history.history['val_accuracy'])
    plt.title('Model Loss')
    plt.ylabel('Loss')
    plt.xlabel('Época')
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.legend(loc='upper right')
    plt.savefig(f"Loss_{path}.png", bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

from keras.models import Sequential
from keras.layers import Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, AveragePooling2D, SpatialDropout2D, Dense, Flatten, BatchNormalization
from keras.optimizers import SGD,Adam,AdamW
from keras.optimizers.schedules import PiecewiseConstantDecay
from keras.losses import CategoricalFocalCrossentropy,CategoricalCrossentropy
In [ ]:
def train_keras_cnn(preprocess=preprocess, **kargs):
    # Preprocess
    if preprocess:
        x = preprocess(x_train)
    else:
        x = x_train

    # Create model
    model = Sequential()
    model.add(Input(shape=(x.shape[-2],x.shape[-1],1)))

    for conv in kargs['convolutions']:
        if 'dropout' in kargs:
            model.add(SpatialDropout2D(rate=kargs['dropout']))
        model.add(Conv2D(**conv))
        if 'batchnorm' in kargs:
            model.add(BatchNormalization())

    if 'dropout' in kargs:
        model.add(SpatialDropout2D(rate=kargs['dropout']))

    if kargs['final_pooling']:
        args = kargs['final_pooling']
        cls = args['type']
        del args['type']
        model.add(cls(**args))

    model.add(Flatten()) # Flatten 2D to 1D
    for size in kargs['hidden_layer_sizes']:
        model.add(Dense(size, kernel_initializer="he_normal", activation='relu'))
    model.add(Dense(10, kernel_initializer="he_normal", activation='softmax')) # Output

    opt_cls = kargs['opt']

    if isinstance(kargs['lr'], dict):
        args = kargs['lr']
        sch_cls = args['type']
        del args['type']
        lr = sch_cls(**args)
    else:
        lr = kargs['lr']

    opt = opt_cls(learning_rate=lr)

    if isinstance(kargs['loss'], dict):
        args = kargs['loss']
        loss_cls = args['type']
        del args['type']
        loss = loss_cls(**args)
    else:
        loss = kargs['loss']

    model.compile(loss=loss, optimizer=opt, metrics=['accuracy'])

    # Train
    y_train_one_hot = to_categorical(y_train, num_classes=10)
    historial = model.fit(
        x, y_train_one_hot,
        epochs=kargs.get('epochs',10),
        batch_size=kargs.get('batch_size',128)
    )

    # Eval
    if preprocess:
        x = preprocess(x_test)
    else:
        x = x_test
    y_test_one_hot = to_categorical(y_test, num_classes=10)
    loss, accuracy = model.evaluate(x, y_test_one_hot, batch_size=60000)
    accuracy = tf.reduce_mean(accuracy)

    return model, historial ,loss, tf.reduce_mean(accuracy)
